topic: Fast AIs vs the slow one that finished every job

sentences.text: Seven minutes, or nineteen seconds: which AI would you trust?
We gave three free AIs the same five coding jobs.
Gemini's solar system runs, every planet moving.
The big gpt-oss one never moved.
The small gpt-oss had a hexagon with one ball.
Gemini took four hundred thirty-four seconds.
The two gpt-oss models each finished in under twenty seconds.
Gemini passed five of five, the fast ones four.
